text: Implemented the first typed low-rank engine slice. Added LowRankComponentCount/LowRankComponentSpec, LatentSketchConfig, LatentSketchMethod, and ReducedRankGlsConfig so rank requests validate before execution. FitInterpreter now lowers LatentSketch and ReducedRankGls: full-rank identity LatentSketch executes through OLS, full-rank ReducedRankGls executes through GLS while preserving requested engine identity, and compressed/sketched requests fail explicitly instead of pretending dense covariance/contrast inference exists. Added direct and future-chunked tests for full-rank fallback equivalence plus compressed-boundary rejection. Evidence: sbt modelJVM/test passed 16; sbt fitJVM/test passed 116 warning-clean; sbt modelJS/test passed 16; sbt fitJS/test passed 113; scoped tracked diff check clean; FitInterpreter trailing-whitespace check clean. Remaining: actual compressed latent basis backend, reduced-rank coefficient/covariance result bundle, and fmrireg lowrank/rrr fixture parity.
